title: Criteria follow their package, and doctor verifies
objective: A hashed work package's criteria and tests are found by its id at every site that reads the group, and doctor proves each hashed id against the event that made it.
body:
Seat: cc. Size: S.

## Scope

- The group of a criterion or test id is its package's id. Four places read it: the close gate (`contract.rs:19-33`, `59-65`), `wp show` and `wp gate` (`facade.rs:5582-5590`), `acceptance.md` (`views.rs:1301-1318`) and doctor (`doctor.rs:820-830`, `1244-1258`, `1427-1431`).
- The gate's roll-up (`contract.rs:888-896`): when no criterion matches a package's group, the gate passes. A hashed package whose criteria carry its group must be judged by them. This is the riskiest site in the census.
- Doctor: `verify(id, origin)`; a duplicate id keyed by the typed id (`doctor.rs:1094-1123`); a canon name of neither family; and an advisory, not counted, that names two records of one kind whose short forms are the same.
- Check how search stems a hex token before search is relied on for ids.

## Order

After WP-06.

## Proof

A test that `wp done` refuses a hashed package with an unsatisfied criterion of its own.
